 €16.47 per hour - Logistics - 38 hour 
We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as a Reachtruck driver at Action in Echt. Are you interested? Read on! 
Within the distribution center you and the team are responsible for handling the pallets. The work is focused on the accurate processing and placement of pallets. It is important that the pallets are always ready at the pick locations on time. In addition to processing the pallets, there is also work at height. The rack height at Action can be from 0 meters to 10 meters high! With the OPT stack, you replace and arrange pallets according to height. You have a well-equipped reach truck, including a camera with a screen. You also work with a scan gun that scans the assignments. As a Reach truck driver, you report to the team management of the IPL department. 
You work an average of 38 hours a week. There are two shifts: the first starts at 06:00 hours and the second starts at 15:15 hours. The end times are flexible. Sometimes you work on Saturdays. On that day there is only a morning shift. Action works with a clock pass. In addition, it is mandatory to wear work shoes as a Reachtruck driver at Action. 
 Job Requirements 
 - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech or good English - Approachable and accurate - You want to work for a longer period of time - Experience in working with a reachtruck is an advantage - Reachtruck certificate 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Possibility for organized accommodation - During the afternoon shift you will receive a free evening meal - Possibility to earn a performance bonus - Additional allowances: 125% between 20:00 and 24:00, and 150% between 00:00 and 06:00 - Coffee, tea and fruit The company you will be working for is a well-known retail chain: Action. We are currently seeking full-time warehouse employees for our new, state-of-the-art distribution center in Oss. This is a long-term position with excellent opportunities for career growth in a dynamic and multicultural environment. Important! This is a physically active role. Lifting crates and materials up to 25 kg is part of the job. Flexibility and a good work ethic are essential! What’s your job about? Inbound: Receive incoming goods from truck drivers. This is not a physically demanding role. CPS (Continuous Packing System): Perform voice picking and operate an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT). While previous experience is preferred, no certifications are required. This role may involve physically demanding tasks depending on the products handled. DPS (Direct Picking System): Similar to pick-to-light systems, products will be delivered to your station. The role requires working efficiently under time pressure but is not physically demanding. The department is located at a higher level in the distribution center, so comfort with heights is essential. Outbound: Organize trolleys and dollies for pick-up. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure products are delivered to the correct locations. This role can be physically demanding, particularly when handling heavier items such as alcohol and cigarettes. Emballage: Manage and recycle empty packaging materials such as bottles, crates, and cans. You will also check trolleys for reuse. This role may involve physically demanding tasks based on the materials handled. You must be flexible, ready to work on each department. What skills do you have? Good command of the English language. Previous experience in logistics and the ability to handle heavier loads (up to 20 kg). Flexibility to work in shifts and willingness to work overtime or weekends when necessary.
